manual.instructions:
Log into your device's mystnode local webdashboard, navigate to the Myst Node page and follow the onscreen instruction to complete the setup.

Disclaimer: If you want to further optimize UPnP and port forwarding, consider setting manually 'network: host' for mystnode in your Docker compose. This may improve mystnode performance, but do this only if you know what you are doing and you are aware of potential security implications.

device_limits.notes: Decentralized network. Unique IP required per node for discoverability. No documented cap. Residential nodes earn more per task due to higher buyer demand.

ip_policy.quality_notes: Algorithm assesses IP location and quality. Residential nodes command premium prices. Staking MYST tokens can boost earnings. Whitelisting (KYC) may be required in some regions.

warnings: Requires NET_ADMIN capability for VPN tunnel creation (TUN/TAP) — legitimate technical requirement for VPN exit node functionality
app_details.compose_layer_reasoning: Decentralized VPN exit node network. Algorithm assesses IP location and quality. Both residential and datacenter nodes supported — residential earn premium prices.
app_details.install_limit_reasoning: Decentralized architecture supports massive scaling. Unique IP required per node for network discoverability.
app_details.recommendation_reasoning: Changed compose_layer from datacenter to universal. Verified residential+DC support in official docs and Docker Hub.
app_details.confidence_notes: Official GitHub, Docker Hub, and Mysterium docs verified. Well-documented open-source project. Verified 2026-05-15 via container test: vendor default binds dashboard to 0.0.0.0:4449 inside the container; the published port mapping reaches the dashboard from the host without any extra startup flag. Command 'service --agreed-terms-and-conditions' is sufficient.
